subject.title: [Bug] Telegram exec approval bubble not dismissed after clicking approve

question: Should maintainers adopt or close the linked fork PR and then land a narrow current-runtime fix for this Telegram approval cleanup bug?
rationale: The bug is narrow and source-reproducible, but an open linked fork PR claims the fix path and same-repo attempts are closed unmerged, so automation should not create a duplicate repair until that path is resolved.

options.title: Replace with current-runtime fix
options.body: Close or disregard the stale linked fork path and land a narrow fix against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with live Telegram proof.

options.title: Adopt the linked fork PR
options.body: Have a maintainer salvage the linked fork work if it can be rebased onto the current approval runtime without obsolete handler changes.

recommendation.title: Replace with current-runtime fix
recommendation.body: Close or disregard the stale linked fork path and land a narrow fix against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with live Telegram proof.
